text:
:= by
intro h
split
· intro s a ha
  have : Finset.cons a s ha = s ∪ {a} := by simp [Finset.cons_eq_union]
  rw [this]
  exact h s (Finset.singleton a) (Finset.disjoint_singleton _ ha)
· intros h'
  intro s t hst
  induction s with a s' IH using Finset.induction_with_top
  · exact hst
  · have : t = s' ∪ {a} := by simp [Finset.union_def, Finset.cons_eq_union, hst]
    rw [this]
    exact h' s' a (Finset.mem_singleton_iff.1 (Finset.not_mem_union.mpr (Finset.mem_singleton_iff.1 (Finset.mem_union_left _))))
    exact (h' s' a (Finset.mem_singleton_iff.1 (Finset.not_mem_union.mpr (Finset.mem_union_right _))))
